import urllib.request, json, urllib.error

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"

def call(text=None, raw_body=None, no_content_type=False):
    if raw_body is not None:
        data = raw_body
    else:
        data = json.dumps({"text": text}).encode()
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    if no_content_type:
        headers = {}
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{BASE}/sentiment", data=data, headers=headers)
    try:
        r = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
        return r.status, json.loads(r.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read())

# Test 1: positive sentiment
code, body = call("I absolutely love this, it's wonderful!")
assert code == 200, f"expected 200 got {code}"
assert body["sentiment"] == "positive", f"got {body['sentiment']}"
assert "positive" in body["confidence"] and "negative" in body["confidence"]
assert 0 <= body["confidence"]["positive"] <= 1
assert 0 <= body["confidence"]["negative"] <= 1
print("Test 1 PASS: positive sentiment ->", body)

# Test 2: negative sentiment
code, body = call("This is terrible, I hate it.")
assert code == 200, f"expected 200 got {code}"
assert body["sentiment"] == "negative", f"got {body['sentiment']}"
print("Test 2 PASS: negative sentiment ->", body)

assert code == 400, f"expected 400 got {code}"
assert "error" in body, f"expected error key, got {body}"
print("Test 3 PASS: missing text -> 400 ->", body)

# Test 4: empty text -> 400 error

assert code == 400, f"expected 400 got {code}"
assert "error" in body
print("Test 4 PASS: empty text -> 400 ->", body)

# Test 5: invalid JSON -> 400 error
code, body = call(raw_body=b'not json at all')
assert code == 400, f"expected 400 got {code}"
assert "error" in body
print("Test 5 PASS: invalid JSON -> 400 ->", body)

# Test 6: non-string text -> 400
code, body = call(raw_body=b'{"text": 123}')
assert code == 400, f"expected 400 got {code}"
assert "error" in body
print("Test 6 PASS: non-string text -> 400 ->", body)

print("\nALL TESTS PASSED")
EOF
